profile.headline: Software Developer at CoverMyMeds
profile.summary:
Programmer and process designer with experience in front- and back-end software engineering, UX/UI design, business process analysis, and ERP implementation; MBA with operations concentration; three years of international work experience.

Primary technical skills: Elixir, Svelte, Ruby, HTML, CSS, Javascript/JQuery, Django, Python, React.js, Node.js

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• ENGINEERING:
- Ticketing: Re-designed and re-implemented client’s existing (non-functioning) web app to be
functional, extensible, easy to navigate, and easy to maintain.
- Integrated Facial Recognition: Co-architected and developed UI and back-end for web application,
as well as software for third-party API and hardware integrations. Beta version has been successfully
deployed in commercial office building.
- Mobile Voting: Built mobile voting web app framework, adding customer-specific feature
customizations and API integrations. Largest election so far tallied over 100,000 votes.
- Event Planning: Developed new Django-based UI and features for event hosts and planners that
integrate with customers’ existing Wordpress site.
• OPEN SOURCE: Contributed functions to Django utilities library ‘kbde’ (for analyzing image quality using OpenCV, and for automatically generating Trello cards).
• PROJECT MANAGEMENT: Lead developer and contact for mobile voting customer and its clients;
coordinated tasks with product and engineering teams to complete new feature development and client
customizations on schedule.
• DESIGN: Produced user flow maps, style guides, and wire-frame page layouts in collaboration with clients and design consultant.
• MARKETING & PRODUCT: Worked with clients’ management teams to brainstorm potential markets, define business requirements and product specifications, and guide copywriting efforts.
• TECH USED: Django, Python, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, JQuery, SQLite, Git, OpenCV, Stripe, Braintree, Twilio, Hubspot, Trello, Raspberry Pi, APIs and wifi-connected hardware.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• FRONT-END ENGINEERING: 
- Lead front-end engineer for LA Local Emmy’s election; integrated new ballot flow and UI into legacy system.
- Developed and published npm package for bi-directional language (BIDI) functionality to allow user to change display language without interrupting the voting process.
- As member of online voting team, developed absentee voting system for state of Montana, voter registration system for DC, online voting platform for Miami NATCA union vote and ‘Cars in Cleveland’ Car Show vote, and election admin sites for Montana, DC, and the Radio Hall of Fame.
• PRODUCT & DESIGN: Collaborated with product, design, and engineering teams to produce highly customizable voting platform and voter registration systems for public and private customers in a variety of industries, keeping user flows simple, and the UI clean, mobile-responsive and accessible.
• MOBILE ENGINEERING: Assisted lead mobile developer with code review and feature development for iOS native mobile application.
• TECH USED: React.js, Redux, Javascript, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, SASS, Node.js, Npm, Docker, Xcode, Swift, Git, Python

positions.title: Production Planning Manager
positions.description:
• ERP INTEGRATION/ADMINISTRATION: Managed integration of manual production planning processes with ERP system; defined data requirements and step-by-step plan for implementation, designed workflows, beta-tested new modules, created new reports required, and addressed technical problems with ERP provider
• QUALITY CONTROL: Identified inefficiencies by mapping business process flows; root-caused delivery variances by expanding data collection; managed 2016 re-certification audit; coordinated internal ISO audits and subsequent corrective action to address findings.
• PRODUCTION: Reviewed potential manufacturing paths, assigned human and machine resources; prioritized and expedited work orders; forecasted shipments; communicated job statuses to sales team.

positions.title: Production Planning and Control Coordinator / Inside Sales Coordinator
positions.description:
• ERP IMPLEMENTATION/ADMINISTRATION: Managed conversion from Epicor to ECI ERP software; designed work flows and oversaw UI customizations; oversaw data clean-up; coordinated with implementation consultants, troubleshooting, and day-to-day administration.
• PROCESS PLANNING: Designed and implemented tools and processes for project planning, resource allocation, advanced materials procurement, requests for new designs, and corrective action requests.
• QUALITY CONTROL: Represented Production and Project Mgmt departments during ISO 9001:2015 upgrade audit; updated relevant procedures and forms in ISO documentation; managed Bill of Material standardization and control; developed product configuration matrix to standardize sales offerings.
• TRAINING: Provided training on new ERP processes to all departments; trained new Doc Control Specialist and sales personnel; conducted procedural and product training for incoming project managers.
• SALES: Tracked opportunities and coordinated/conducted follow-ups; issued machine and service quotes; reviewed pricing and contract terms; led engineering order reviews for new contracts.

positions.title: Operations Administrator (Intern)
positions.description: • Prepared contract documentation and international shipping forms; point-of-contact for customers and customs officials; issued purchase orders and invoices; researched manufacturer quotes; documented Operations procedures to quality manual.

positions.title: Assistant English Teacher
positions.description: •  Taught students aged 4-15 in 20 schools; responsible for leading classes, lesson planning, creating instructional materials, preparing students for high schools exams and English placement exams, grading oral exams and written assignments, and presenting at city’s cultural events.

projects.title: Transracial Journeys Website Redesign
projects.description:
• Cleveland GiveCamp 2017 project: In two days, design and build easy-to-maintain website and event registration forms for non-profit org supporting racially-mixed adoptive families.
• Technologies: Wordpress templates and plug-ins mixed with custom CSS and PHP.

projects.title: Bevy
projects.description:
• An app to provide the user with a map-based representation of what events are happening in their area.  Offers the user the option to sort by event category and timeframe.
• Technologies: HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, APIs, Twitter integration.
